display_name: Corporate, non-corporate, and business profit rates with capacity utilization

triage.reason: Faithful reconstruction of Shaikh Figures 6.1/6.4/6.5 (Ch6). Three sectoral profit-rate lines (corporate, non-corporate, business), 1947-2011, plus Shaikh's cointegration-derived capacity-utilization measure and the Federal Reserve comparison, transcribed from Shaikh's Appendix 6.8 tables. Construction-relevant: the central regulator of accumulation and the basis for treating the corporate rate as a proxy for the general rate. Profit rates and utilization carry different units, split per subseries.
